title: Abraham's Gentle Words to His Father

paragraphs.text: Allah will inherit the earth and everyone on it, and all will return to Him.

Abraham was a truthful man and a prophet. He asked his father, "Why do you worship what cannot hear, see or help you?" He said knowledge had come to him, so his father should follow him to a straight path. He warned him not to worship Satan, who disobeyed the Most Merciful. He feared a punishment would touch his father. His father said, "Do you turn away from my gods? If you do not stop, I will stone you. Stay away from me." Abraham answered, "Peace be on you. I will ask my Lord to forgive you, for He is kind to me." He said he would leave them and pray only to his Lord.
When he left them, Allah gave him Isaac and Jacob and made each of them a prophet. He gave them His mercy and a high, honored name.

Moses was chosen, a messenger and a prophet. Allah called him from the right side of the mountain and brought him near. He made his brother Aaron a prophet too. Ishmael kept his promises. He told his people to pray and give zakah, and his Lord was pleased with him. Idrees was also a truthful man and a prophet.

hardWords.m: stop blaming someone for a wrong
